We were doing a conversation in an action popup. there were a couple of tasks to complete. the UI appeared as if it was stuck on task 2, and everything was still running.

however, when I tried to send a new prompt, we got:

> Failed to send
> Action run no longer accepts queued prompts: action-ff817ecc-7aa9-4c48-9598-f408510baec0
>

The ui was clearly in a bad state, the prompt was ready but the UI did not see it. I think something got broken perhaps in recent refactoring?

_4\J_022_stabilize_action_prompt_drafts.md:23:Give each action prompt draft one lifetime-stable external store. Typing, flushing, preparing, replacing, clearing, restoring, and remotely synchronizing a prompt must not place the prompt text or reset counters in `ActionPopupContent` or its controller React state.
designeleases\0_0_4\J_022_stabilize_action_prompt_drafts.md:31:- `useActionPopupController` stores prompt value, preparation status, and reset token in React state.
designeleases\0_0_4\J_022_stabilize_action_prompt_drafts.md:32:- `ActionPopupContent` creates a new `ActionPromptDraft` whenever the controller prompt or reset token changes.
designeleases\0_0_4\J_022_stabilize_action_prompt_drafts.md:58:- `ActionPopupContent` obtains or receives the stable draft store but does not subscribe to its value or preparation state.
designeleases\0_0_4\J_022_stabilize_action_prompt_drafts.md:59:- `useActionPopupController` removes `promptState`, `promptResetToken`, prompt-value derivation, and `handlePromptChange` state updates.
designeleases\0_0_4\J_022_stabilize_action_prompt_drafts.md:61:- `ActionPopupBottomRow` remains the narrow subscriber for live prompt-dependent button state.
designeleases\0_0_4\J_022_stabilize_action_prompt_drafts.md:68:- Normal typing does not render `ActionPopupContent`, the popup controller owner, or unrelated popup sections.
designeleases\0_0_4\J_022_stabilize_action_prompt_drafts.md:82:- Popup regression tests count renders and prove repeated typing and flushes do not render `ActionPopupContent`.

designeleases\0_0_3\F_061_worktree_select_on_action_popup.md:14:User can select the active worktree from the action popup. When the action popup is associated to a card, it reflects the worktree of that card (and also updates it). When the action popup is for the project agent, then the user can select the worktree on which to run the agent project wide.
designeleases\0_0_3\F_83_chatlog_sticky_at_end.md:20:`ActionPopupContent` provides the chat scroll container. `ActionConversationChat` renders the selected or live conversation, but neither component tracks whether the viewport is at the end. Loading a conversation and streaming new content therefore leave the scroll position unchanged.
designeleases\0_0_3\F_63_electron_action_execution_and_chaining.md:15:Move the complete action runner to Electron. Electron resolves a persisted action by stable id, prepares its worktree when requested, executes command or agent actions, orchestrates `onBefore`/main/`on`/`onAfter`, streams phase-specific events, and supports cancellation.
designeleases\0_0_3\F_63_electron_action_execution_and_chaining.md:23:- Add one Electron `ActionRunner` used by manual, `onState`, scheduled, and related-action runs.
designeleases\0_0_3\F_63_electron_action_execution_and_chaining.md:28:- Delegate agent-process lifecycle to the Electron agent runner while retaining chain ownership in the Electron action runner.
designeleases\0_0_3\F_63_electron_action_execution_and_chaining.md:40:- Manual, state-triggered, scheduled, and related-action runs share one Electron action runner.
designeleases\0_0_3\F_64_agent_actions.md:15:Execute `agent` actions through the Electron action runner with run-specific prompt input, one structured process per turn, cancellation, history for the same action id/context, and conversion of custom prompts to reusable definitions.
designeleases\0_0_3\F_64_agent_actions.md:23:- The popup sends the action `id`, context, and run-specific agent/model/thinking-level and extra-prompt input to the Electron action runner. It does not send the persisted `prompt` or executable agent command.
designeleases\0_0_3\F_64_agent_actions.md:29:- Cancelling the action asks the Electron action runner to stop the agent process and chain.
